import json
from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.engine.io import digest,file_digest,write_json
from nisayon.engine.temporal_workflow import load_assessment
from scripts.experiments.audit_temporal_reconciliation import archive_packet
raw=Path("artifacts/engine-integration-001/temporal-integration-001/clock-conformance-001")
root=Path("docs/experiments/results/temporal-integration-001")
report=load_assessment(raw/"assessment",raw/"execution")
rows=[];by_id={};traces={}
for row in report["assignments"]:
 detail=json.loads((raw/"assessment"/row["detail"]["path"]).read_bytes())
 identity=row["assignment"]["id"]
 reference=detail["reference_assessment"]
 trace=detail["inspection"]["trace"]
 normalized=[{k:v for k,v in e.items() if k not in ("input_id","delivery_id","dispatch_id")} for e in trace["events"]]
 entry={"assignment":row["assignment"],"trace_sha256":digest(trace),"integrity":row["integrity"],"process_outcome":row["process_outcome"],"reference_assessment":reference,"normalized_event_sha256":digest(normalized),"original_execution_costs":row["original_execution_costs"]}
 rows.append(entry);by_id[identity]=entry;traces[identity]=trace
pairs=[]
for remedy in ("unfenced_queue_control","conventional"):
 a="C02-conflicting-fresh-first--"+remedy;b="C03-conflicting-stale-first--"+remedy
 mappings_a=traces[a]["clocks"]["declared_mappings"];mappings_b=traces[b]["clocks"]["declared_mappings"]
 assert mappings_a==list(reversed(mappings_b))
 assert by_id[a]["normalized_event_sha256"]==by_id[b]["normalized_event_sha256"]
 pairs.append({"remedy":remedy,"fresh_first":a,"stale_first":b,"mapping_multiset_equal":True,"logical_events_equal_after_scoped_id_removal":True,"removed_identity_fields":["input_id","delivery_id","dispatch_id"],"assigned_contracts":[by_id[a]["reference_assessment"]["assigned_contract"],by_id[b]["reference_assessment"]["assigned_contract"]],"freshness":[by_id[a]["reference_assessment"]["predicates"]["freshness"]["status"],by_id[b]["reference_assessment"]["predicates"]["freshness"]["status"]]})
assert pairs[0]["assigned_contracts"]==["satisfied","violated"]
assert pairs[1]["assigned_contracts"]==["violated","violated"]
archive=archive_packet(raw,root/"clock-conformance-001.tar.gz")
result={"schema":"nisayon.temporal-clock-conformance.v1","execution_source_commit":"7022cca5b96df4e47fa69673fd4eea6f734f3566","evaluation_delivery":"8e5465051a583823ce8bf3914846e71046fbdeee","reference_module_sha256":file_digest(Path("src/nisayon/evaluation/temporal.py")),"capture":json.loads((raw/"capture.json").read_bytes()),"frozen_suite_sha256":file_digest(root/"frozen-clock-conformance.v1.json"),"assignments":rows,"permutation_pairs":pairs,"archive":archive,"conclusion":"Observed reference order dependence on conflicting clock declarations with no declared priority. The producer conventional guard refuses both; no robot acceptance or product advantage. Correct invalid-versus-unresolved disposition belongs to the evaluation owner.","new_simulator_executions":0,"scientific_acceptance":"not_granted"}
write_json(root/"clock-conformance-001.json",result)
print(json.dumps({"pairs":pairs,"archive_bytes":archive["bytes"]},indent=2))
